query: UPDATE scan_tasks t SET acknowledged_at = now() FROM scan_runs r LEFT JOIN providers p ON p.id = r.provider_id WHERE r.id = t.run_id AND t.state = 'failed' AND t.acknowledged_at IS NULL AND ($1::text IS NULL OR p.slug = $1) AND ($2::timestamptz IS NULL OR t.finished_at >= $2) AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR t.run_id = $3) AND (NOT $4::bool OR t.error IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $5::text)
